## (b) The variation check, kp3 (pre-repair (engine 7fc6ccb); re-run at the repaired engine when it becomes the baseline)

Each version plays its deck's 500 deals per pairing exactly as the main list did (same seeds, same seats), so every difference is paired deal by deal. **The rule, set in advance (Proposal B): a version whose average over its opponents (7, or 8 for Charizard Y) moves by 3 points or more puts that deck's second list into the big gauntlet.** It reads the opponent average only. Per-cell numbers are for information: a single-Trainer swap is about +/-4 points per cell at 500 deals, so single cells never trigger it.
